question: What becomes of those who drink the immortal dharma with faith?
premises: faithful devotees who practice the declared dharma are exceedingly dear
one without fixed resolve accepts what comes
absorption in the supreme Lord brings supreme isolation
inference: The verse links faithful practice, non-attachment to resolve, and absorption in the Lord to attainment of supreme isolation.
uncertainties: several fused tokens contain internal sandhi and compound boundaries
plain_english: Those who faithfully practice this immortal dharma are exceedingly dear; one without fixed resolve, accepting what comes and absorbed in the supreme Lord, easily attains supreme isolation.
